whatItDoes: said-vs-derived.mjs (Node built-ins only) reads an Aster checkout. It collects what the code already owns: top-level numeric and date constants, the first-level fields of top-level const objects, and the screening cache's metadata head. It then lexes every string and template literal in src/v2 and mcp/src, plus the HTML entry pages, and reports display text that types a value one of those constants owns (matched on dimension, value and a shared name word), literal dates and year spans, code literals that retype a constant, dates typed in several files, and quantities defined in two or more files. It applies an allow-list in which every entry needs a reason, and exits 0, 1 or 2. Against 62ddb17 it finds 10 LITERAL-MATCHES-CONSTANT, 2 LITERAL-DATE-SPAN, 26 RETYPED-CONSTANT, 9 DUPLICATE-DATE, 17 TWO-HOMES (7 allowed under a proposed list) and 18 informational findings, 57 of them failing. index.html shows that saved run with Said/Derived pair cards and filters, and runs the same said-derived.js on a pasted snippet.
testsPin:
All 21 node tests pass (about 4 to 7 s) and all 37 ui-check checks pass. External pins:
(1) The TypeScript 6.0.2 parser (global npm) is the oracle for the lexer. Every literal's position and cooked text matches it on the 5 whole-file snapshots and on all 121 scanned checkout files. A one-off run, not a test, also matched on 342 files and 20,899 literals.
(2) The values in Aster's cache metadata snapshot: feasibleC3MaxKm2S2 = 25, and coorbitalCriteria.aDeltaKm = 7479893.535, which is exactly 0.05 au under the IAU 2012 definition (149,597,870,700 m). 0.051 au and 0.05% are checked not to match.

(4) A byte-for-byte reproduction of example.txt by a fresh run when the checkout is at 62ddb17, plus checks of the proposal's cited lines (STATUS.md:418, SLICE_17_FOUNDING.md:203, SLICE_19_5_FOUNDING.md:176, and 446e3a7 being an ancestor of HEAD).
(5) An exact 18-finding list from a synthetic fixture tree that the test writes to a temp dir and removes afterwards.

findingsAboutSourceRepo:
All observed in Aster at 62ddb17; none fixed there.
(1) src/v2/app/catalog-list/honesty-disclosure.ts:59 types "departure C3 ≤ 25 km²/s²". Meanwhile compare/main.ts:956 reads metadata.feasibleC3MaxKm2S2 at run time. DEC-17-5's text (SLICE_17_FOUNDING.md:197-212, at the repo root) binds compare surfaces, so for the catalog this falls under the house rule and DEC-19.5-8 (PROPOSED), not a broken lock. On line :68 of the same file, "within 0.05 AU" restates the cache's coorbitalCriteria.aDeltaKm = 7479893.535 km, which is exactly 0.05 au.
(2) compare/main.ts:270 types "(0.053–0.166)" although ALBEDO_C_COMPLEX/ALBEDO_S_COMPLEX are exported at :222-223, and :271 interpolates the other albedo constants. compare/main.ts:842 types 0.053–0.166 and 0.14, which is ASTEROID_DEFAULT_ALBEDO (core/constants/asteroids.ts:9).
(3) mcp/src/tools/estimate-mission-cost.ts:247 and :270, and explain-cell.ts:264, type "5%". The constant is DETERMINISTIC_MARGIN_FRACTION (launch-vehicles.ts:59), from which porkchop/main.ts:160, :868 and :892 derive their text.
(4) mcp compute-shared.ts:367 types "as-of 2024-02-29" and mcp/src/resources/reference.ts:37 types '2024-02-29', both restating ELVPERF_AS_OF (launch-vehicles.ts:66). porkchop/main.ts:889 types "queried 2026-07-02", a date that otherwise exists only in comments.
(5) TDB−UTC 69.184 is retyped at 7 sites in 5 files: compute-shared.ts:136 and :144, compare/main.ts:96, porkchop-smoke/main.ts:33, porkchop/main.ts:167 and :189, ui-overlay/overlay.ts:153. 946_728_000 sits beside it at the same sites. The core exports TDB_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS (core/units/utc-to-tdb.ts:28) and says at :14-16 to update that one constant on a new leap second.
(6) '2026-01-01' and '2040-01-01' are typed in 4 files: compare/main.ts:106-107, porkchop-smoke/main.ts:65-66, porkchop/main.ts:195-196, overlay.ts:160-161. TOF 182.5/1826.25 is retyped at porkchop-smoke:67-68 and overlay:162-163. The cache window ends 2040-12-31 (S17-F2, unfixed).

deviationsFromProposal:
- The proposal's reconciliation expected honesty-disclosure.ts to give LITERAL-WITH-UNITS for 25 km²/s². By its own class definitions that literal is LITERAL-MATCHES-CONSTANT once the cache metadata is read. It is LITERAL-WITH-UNITS only with --no-cache, and the tests cover both cases.
- Citations corrected: SLICE_17_FOUNDING.md is at the repo root and DEC-17-5 runs :197-212; compare/main.ts:874 is a doc comment, so :956 is the only runtime read. DEC-19.5-8 added. The README notes that DEC-17-5 binds compare surfaces only.
- Scope widened from app/porkchop/HTML to all of src/v2 (minus tests and prototypes) plus mcp/src, because MCP text is display text for agents and holds 3 of the 10 matches.
- Classes added: RETYPED-CONSTANT, DUPLICATE-DATE and TWO-HOMES. LITERAL-WITH-UNITS is informational rather than failing.
- Matching needs a shared name word as well as an equal value; without it, "1 AU" matched a 1 AU grid cell.
- The cache head is read from the first 64 KB, not 4 KB.
- Unit handling covers AU/km/m, km/s and m/s, and % against fractions, plus 10^N and "million".
- The DERIVED list follows one level of in-file indirection, and runtime reads of cache fields are listed.
- The allow-list accepts line-free ids, reports stale entries, and exits 2 on an entry without a reason.
- The TypeScript parser is used as a test oracle instead of building the tool on the TS AST, because the tool must use Node built-ins only.
- The synthetic fixture tree is embedded in the test and written to a temp dir, which keeps the folder at 484 KB by du -sk. Reconciliation also runs on a provenance-sidecarred snapshot tree of Aster's own files.
- The STATUS staleness is credited to idea 10.
- A proposed allow-list of 7 renderer-tuning entries is shipped. It is explicitly not agreed by anyone.
notBuilt:
- No render-level check: the tool cannot see numbers a page builds at run time from literals.
- Known misses the heuristics cannot see:
  - two homes whose names share no word (DEFAULT_ABSOLUTE_KM2S2 against the cache's feasibleC3MaxKm2S2; SELECTED_BODY_SET_CAP as the third cap)
  - thresholds that have no name at all (compare/main.ts:306/309 "code ≥ 7")
  - numbers spelled as words ("up to five asteroids")
  - labels assembled by arithmetic on literals
- Error/throw messages are excluded from display by rule, so a thrown message that a page shows would be missed.
- HTML scanning is regex-based.
- Line-numbered allow-list ids go stale when lines shift.
- The allow-list is my proposal and has not been through Aster's DEC process.
- The tool has not run in Aster's CI or been through its multi-agent audit or founding-doc process.
- The TypeScript-oracle test skips when the typescript package is not installed globally, and the live tests skip without the checkout at 62ddb17.
- The page's snippet box scans one file only, so it cannot show duplicate dates or two-homes findings.
